summary.method: All admitted single/pair status substitutions, optional obligation activation, native semantic outcomes/support flag, nested PRF six product values, plus literal malformed/truthiness controls. This is finite transition coverage, not all Cartesian combinations of fourteen layers.

decisionTable.condition: Invalid inventory, data representation, native semantic vocabulary, required-layer list or support flag
Any supplied layer/nested PRF product result is REJECTED_MALFORMED
Any supplied layer/nested PRF contradicts/violates OR recomputation semantic result is REFUTED
Unsupported profile OR a required layer/nested PRF is unsupported
Required recomputation unavailable/diverged OR required nested PRF is CANNOT_RECOMPUTE
Mandatory or selected positive premise is unestablished
All guards clear; all required successes established; native semantic result positive
